name: analyze_intent_switch_response
description: Analyze user's response to intent switch choice prompt to determine if they want to continue current workflow or switch to new intent

chosen_action.description: The user's chosen action based on their response

confidence.description: Confidence score as percentage (0-100) for the classification

reasoning.description: Brief explanation of why this action was chosen based on the user's message

detected_keywords.description: Key words or phrases that influenced the decision

ambiguity_level.description: Level of ambiguity in the user's response
